         gzhan lugs dgag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3820">kha 1</rs><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3820">'dul 'dzin <expan>la sogs pa</expan></rs></note> na re skye <expan>med</expan> gsum maM mkhyen 3 bsdus bsgoM zhes zer ba ltar na sbyor ba gzhan 3 rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bye brag tu thal | skye <expan>med</expan> 3 maM mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom gyi <expan>bye brag</expan> yin pa'i phyir | rtags bsdus pa nyid du rtogs pa'i don rnaMs bsgom zhes pa'i lung gis grub | <lb n="27a1"/> khyab pa khas blangs 'dod pa la lung rigs khas blangs 3 gyis <expan>bsal lo</expan> || </seg></TEI>
